value.rationale: One-spin kinetic energy-landscape complexity is a natural quantity not determined by equilibrium ground-state entropy or Glauber relaxation exponents. Its sharp nonmonotone marginal peak, exact quintic and septic Perron rates and exponential separation between coupling regimes give a structural, nontrivial benchmark distinct from known subcritical domain counts.
